content: macOS exposes low-level keyboard and pointer events through Quartz event taps and native window event handling, while system privacy controls gate monitoring of keyboard, mouse, and trackpad input. The client must preflight Input Monitoring or Accessibility access, expose pointer-capture state and an escape path, release pressed state on focus loss, and report rather than promise interception of OS-reserved shortcuts. The exact shortcut pass-through matrix needs live testing on every supported macOS release. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coregraphics/cgevent and https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/control-access-to-input-monitoring-on-mac-mchl4cedafb6/mac.
